title: University of Cagliari people collect the artifacts and giant bodies

tellings.quote: certain individuals who were associated with the University of Kajetti, the capital city in Sardinia.

plain: Between about 1978 and 1981, people connected with the University of Cagliari, in the capital of the Italian island of Sardinia, are said to have collected artifacts and the bodies of giants. The filmmaker Tim Alberino tells Michels this as something he was told by others, which would mean evidence of giants was gathered up and kept out of view.
